svg.text: One request: where TTFT and TPOT are spent, and which knob moves each
Each stop: the time we measured there and a knob we turned. Stage times overlap, so they do not add up.
TTFT: until the first token (never under ~43 ms here, even for a 256-token prompt)
resizes the pools · 2 to 3 min per move

rect.style: transform-origin: 770px 313px; animation: cold 69.44s linear infinite; transform: scaleX(0);

g.text: Frontend and router: decide where the prompt runs (TTFT)
Time: the routing decision takes ~0.1 ms when nothing queues.
Knob: --router-prefill-load-scale 10: prefix hit rate 0.64 → 0.89, median TTFT unchanged at 44.6 ms.
Knob: --router-queue-threshold 0.5 under overload: TTFT p90 352 → 144 ms, ~34 ms router wait, TPOT +8%.
Part 3
Prefill: sets TTFT; on a shared GPU it also sets TPOT
Time: a 3,000-token prompt keeps an H100 busy ~70 ms (Nsight, upper bound); one user's TTFT is 79 ms.
On one shared GPU at 64 users: one token gap in ten is ~200 ms, the median ~17 ms.
Knob (shared GPU): --max-num-batched-tokens 512 at 64 users: TPOT 43.7 → 17.6 ms, TTFT p50 0.6 → 4.8 s.
Parts 2 and 6
KV transfer: adds to TTFT, and posting it stalls running decodes
Time, 6,000-token KV cache (~845 MiB) over NVLink: 5.4 ms idle, ~93 ms under load.
Why: under load it is ~13,400 scattered spans, each posted by the CPU in ~3.8 μs: ~51 ms of the ~93.
Knob: --block-size 64: transfer ~93 → ~26 ms; 64 prompt-heavy users: TPOT 12.7 → 10.2 ms, TTFT p50 2.9 → 3.3 s.
Part 4
Decode: sets TPOT, one engine step per token
Time: a step reads the weights and KV cache: 6.85 ms at 1 user, 9.94 ms at 64 (short prompts).
Knob: FP8 weights: TPOT 7.59 → 5.41 ms (-29%) at 16 short-prompt users; accuracy not evaluated.
Knob: prefill/decode split: TPOT 23.8 → 12.7 ms at 64 prompt-heavy users (2 GPUs).
Parts 2, 4 and 6
Planner: sets capacity, in minutes rather than seconds
Time: each move deletes a pod and cold-starts another: 1 min 51 s to 2 min 49 s.
Setting (not varied): load thresholds checked every 10 s. A pod was cold-starting ~75% of the 5-minute
prefill phase (1,500-token prompts, 48 users, MIG slices on 2x H100).
Part 5
End to end: measured TTFT p50 and TPOT, prompt-heavy traffic on 2 H100s
Part 4
16 users: TTFT p50 · TPOT
64 users: TTFT p50 · TPOT
Two aggregated GPUs + KV router
Prefill/decode split
16 users: the split wins both at p50 (p99 TTFT 1,234 vs 594 ms). 64 users: TPOT halves, TTFT grows 4.8x, req/s -24%.
Router: --router-prefill-load-scale 10, hit rate 0.64 → 0.89 (Part 3)
Prefill: chunk budget 512, one GPU, 64 users: TPOT 43.7 → 17.6 ms, TTFT p50 0.6 → 4.8 s (Part 6)
KV transfer: --block-size 64, ~93 → ~26 ms per loaded transfer, a partial fix (Part 4)
Decode: FP8 weights, TPOT -29% at 16 users; prefill/decode split, TPOT 23.8 → 12.7 ms (Parts 4, 6)
Planner: 1 min 51 s to 2 min 49 s per move (Part 5)
